raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Order processor Lambda function triggered by SQS queue

Parameters:
  FunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: order-processor
    Description: Name of the Lambda function
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention period in days
  ReservedConcurrency:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    Description: Reserved concurrent executions for the Lambda function
  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Maximum receives before message goes to DLQ

Resources:
  OrderProcessorDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: alias/aws/sqs
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  OrderProcessorQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-queue'
      VisibilityTimeout: 180
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      KmsMasterKeyId: alias/aws/sqs
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt OrderProcessorDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: !Ref MaxReceiveCount

  OrderProcessorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${FunctionName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  OrderProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderProcessorLogGroup.Arn
        - PolicyName: SQSConsumePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn

  OrderProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: OrderProcessorLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref FunctionName
      Description: Processes order messages from SQS queue
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt OrderProcessorRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      ReservedConcurrentExecutions: !Ref ReservedConcurrency
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
          POWERTOOLS_SERVICE_NAME: order-processor
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get('LOG_LEVEL', 'INFO'))


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              """Process SQS messages containing order data."""
              batch_item_failures = []
              sqs_batch_response = {}

              for record in event.get('Records', []):
                  try:
                      message_id = record['messageId']
                      body = json.loads(record['body'])
                      logger.info(f"Processing order: {message_id}")
                      # TODO: Implement order processing logic
                      process_order(body)
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.exception(f"Error processing message {record.get('messageId')}: {e}")
                      batch_item_failures.append({'itemIdentifier': record['messageId']})

              sqs_batch_response['batchItemFailures'] = batch_item_failures
              return sqs_batch_response


          def process_order(order):
              """Implement order processing business logic here."""
              logger.info(f"Order processed: {order}")
              return True

  OrderProcessorEventSourceMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !GetAtt OrderProcessorFunction.Arn
      BatchSize: 10
      MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 5
      FunctionResponseTypes:
        - ReportBatchItemFailures
      ScalingConfig:
        MaximumConcurrency: !Ref ReservedConcurrency

Outputs:
  FunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FunctionArn'
  FunctionName:
    Description: Name
